title: Parametric Staircase Geometry — 3D
description: Real Three.js straight-flight stair whose riser height, going count, run, width, and geometric pitch are driven by one deterministic model.
learningObjectives: Compute individual riser height from total rise and riser count.
Relate the number of goings to horizontal run while inspecting the stair as spatial geometry.
Read rise, going, width, run, and geometric pitch without treating the asset as a code-compliance check.

rights.attribution: Original LearnMat procedural 3D geometry; no third-party models, textures, fonts, or datasets are embedded.

verification.notes: The existing rise/going arithmetic is preserved and now drives real Three.js stair solids. Independent engineering, browser, and accessibility review remain required before approval.

source.reference: 3D replacement of reserved buildings-agent task bld-staircase.
